protocol: Implement and validate translation rules on the two training predicates, freeze their exact bytes and source/interface manifests, then evaluate consumption without altering frozen rules. A rejection is an expected admissible outcome. Any adaptation would require a separately labeled later version.
prior_exposure: The author knows CSS and the prior pilot; broad local search exposed snippets of the consumption algorithm before this protocol. This is a frozen-rule transfer experiment, not blind unfamiliarity, independent authoring, or an unbiased accuracy estimate.
success_criteria: Two training predicates generate executable Lean from recognized source clauses
Correspondence to pre-existing independent library relations is kernel checked for all list inputs
Held-out result reports refusal or checked support without silent adaptation
Wrong semantics, boundary and state effects are rejected by appropriate controls
limitations: Spec prose meanings and interfaces are manually chosen
Three deliberately selected algorithms cannot estimate CSS-wide coverage
